mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM payment_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND i.start_time <= NOW() AND i.end_time >= NOW() AND ( i.target_scope = 'ALL' OR (i.target_scope = 'GRADE' AND (JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(#{grade})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, CAST(#{grade} AS JSON)))) OR (i.target_scope = 'COLLEGE' AND JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(#{college}))) OR (i.target_scope = 'MAJOR' AND JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(#{major}))) OR (i.target_scope = 'CUSTOM' AND (JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, CAST(#{studentId} AS JSON)) OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{studentId} AS CHAR))))) ) ORDER BY i.end_time ASC, i.id ASC
